Role Summary Ascensos, a Firstsource company, is a customer management services and digital solutions provider that partners with leading global brands to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Through a blend of people, technology, data, and innovation, Ascensos supports clients across multiple industries by helping them improve customer engagement, marketing performance, and business outcomes. We are seeking a detail-oriented and inquisitive Manufacturing Engineer to support a U.S.-based manufacturing services operation. This position focuses on reviewing mechanical drawings, engineering specifications, and 3D models to identify potential manufacturing challenges before parts are released for production. As a DFM Project Engineer, you're primarily responsible for working with customers across an array of industries, including aerospace, defense, commercial, automotive, industrial, and medical devices. It is critical that you have the ability to evaluate the manufacturability of customer designs and recommend solutions utilizing Xometry’s extensive portfolio of technologies. Our typical shift pattern involves: Monday to Sunday between 7 AM - 11 PM, on a rotational basis. Please note: This position is full time and based at our site in Port of Spain, Trinidad & Tobago. As part of #theAteam, you’ll receive full training and support to be the voice of our client’s brand. So, there’s no room for average. Key Responsibilities Review mechanical drawings, blueprints, CAD models, and technical specifications for manufactured components. Identify potential issues involving dimensions, tolerances, materials, geometry, or manufacturing feasibility. Review customer requirements and supporting order documentation to identify inconsistencies before production. Investigate technical discrepancies and determine when further clarification or engineering review is necessary. Collaborate with engineering teams and manufacturing partners to evaluate whether components can be produced as designed. Communicate technical findings, questions, and potential concerns clearly and professionally. Develop your knowledge of manufacturing processes, including CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, and other production methods. \ Qualifications & Experience We believe that happy people keep people happy, so we’re looking for people who have excellent interpersonal skills and strong analytical skills as you will be expected to deal with a range of customer queries. We’re delighted to drive innovation on-site day after day, so it’s a plus if you’re inventive and creative; we say yes to fresh new ideas to boost productivity, so reach out and help us shape the future. We think big and we’re looking for team members who think bigger, achieve more and work smarter. Full training will be provided, but we want to hear from you if you have the following skills! B.Sc in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. 2-3 years experience in reading drawings, setting up machinery, inspecting components, or verifying dimensional tolerances. 2-3 years hands-on experience reviewing mechanical parts and specifications. Understanding of mechanical design, CAD, 3D printing, or prototyping. Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and dimensional specifications. Foundational understanding of mechanical components, materials, dimensions, and tolerances. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities. Curiosity and willingness to research unfamiliar manufacturing challenges. Ability to clearly communicate technical information. Nice-to-Have Experience Familiarity with GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing). Experience with SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Fusion 360, or similar CAD software. Exposure to CNC milling, turning, sheet metal fabrication, or additive manufacturing. Experience using measuring instruments or performing dimensional inspections. Familiarity with STEP files, engineering change requests, or manufacturing documentation. Experience communicating with suppliers, machinists, or engineering teams. Benefits Full training & support. Well-being with Nozuko ( virtual counselling). Free gym membership to Sky Gym*. Health insurance*. 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Hub. Birthday holiday (after 3 consecutive months of employment). Nationwide retail discounts via Medicare*. 'Refer a Friend' scheme. Opportunities to progress your career with us (more than 90% of advancement and promotions come from our internally developed talent pool). Employee of the Month’ Awards. Regular fun team-building sessions. A diverse & inclusive working environment. * Available post 3-month probationary period.
